commits.subject: net: THttpServer OnThreadStart/OnThreadTerminate events were never called for its thread pool
commits.body: - TSynThreadPoolTHttpServer did copy the server OnThreadTerminate but not OnThreadStart, so TSynThreadPoolWorkThread.NotifyThreadStart never ran the callback nor set StartNotified, and TSynThread.DoTerminate then skipped OnThreadTerminate
commits.author: mobius1qwe
